tour.title: Signature Global Rosalia — 2BHK Apartment, Sector 84
tour.description: A walkable 360° tour of a lived-in, family-occupied 2BHK apartment at Signature Global Rosalia, Sector 84, New Gurgaon. The home spans 965 sq ft on the 7th floor with a Scandinavian-leaning, light-wood interior, a road-facing balcony, and easy access to Dwarka Expressway. Start at the entrance and walk through the living room hub to the bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and balcony.

scenes.title: Entrance Foyer
scenes.caption: Compact foyer with the main door, shoe rack and the family's everyday clutter.
scenes.description: The apartment's entrance foyer, anchored by a solid teak main door with a 'Kumar's' nameplate and a Ganesha motif for an auspicious welcome. A wooden shoe rack stacked with the family's footwear, a school backpack and a child's scooter give away the home's lived-in, family-with-kids character. The space opens left into the living and dining area and right into the bedroom-and-bathroom hallway.
scenes.narration: Welcome home. You're standing just inside the main door of this 2BHK at Signature Global Rosalia. Notice the practical shoe rack and the little signs of family life — a school bag, a child's scooter. To your left the foyer opens straight into the bright living and dining area; to the right a short hallway leads to the bedrooms and bathroom. Step ahead into the living room to begin the tour.

scenes.title: Living Room & Dining
scenes.caption: The central living and dining hub, with sofa, TV unit and a dining set by the balcony.
scenes.description: The heart of the home — a 15' x 11'6" living room combined with a dining area. A large L-shaped sage-green sofa wraps around a low wooden coffee table, facing a wall-mounted TV on a light-wood console. Beyond the seating, a four-seater dining set sits near the balcony's glass doors, which flood the room with daylight. Doorways lead off to the master bedroom and bathroom on one side, the kitchen on the other, and the entrance foyer behind the open teak door. This room connects to every other space in the apartment.
scenes.narration: This is the living room — the hub the whole apartment revolves around. The comfortable sectional sofa and coffee table make up the family lounge, while a dining set sits by the balcony doors where the light pours in. From here you can reach everywhere: the master bedroom and bathroom to one side, the kitchen to the other, the balcony straight ahead, and the entrance behind you. Take your pick of where to wander next.

scenes.title: Master Bedroom
scenes.caption: A roomy master bedroom with a queen bed, wardrobe and an attached bathroom.
scenes.description: A generous 12' x 13' master bedroom with a wooden-framed queen bed dressed in soft blue-grey bedding. A light-wood wardrobe, a chest of drawers crowded with family photo frames, and a tall steel almirah provide ample storage. Sheer curtains over a balcony-style window let in plenty of daylight. An open door leads back to the living and dining area, and a second door on the far side opens to the room's attached bathroom.
scenes.narration: Here's the master bedroom — the largest in the home at twelve by thirteen feet. There's a comfortable queen bed, a roomy wardrobe, and a dresser topped with family photographs. The big window keeps the room bright and airy. The door on one side takes you back out to the living area, and the one opposite leads into the attached bathroom.

scenes.title: Kitchen
scenes.caption: A functional L-shaped kitchen with granite counters, gas hob and a breakfast nook.
scenes.description: A practical 8' x 10' kitchen with an L-shaped granite countertop, light-wood modular cabinetry and a stainless-steel sink under a barred window. A four-burner gas hob sits beneath a chimney, with a tall fridge, RO water purifier and plenty of shelved storage for jars and provisions. A small round breakfast counter with two stools tucks into the corner. The doorway on the far side opens back to the living room, and a rear passage leads to the utility and drying area.
scenes.narration: This is the kitchen — compact but well laid out, with an L-shaped granite counter, a gas hob under the chimney, and a fridge tucked beside the dining nook. There's generous overhead storage for the family's jars and provisions, and a little two-stool breakfast counter in the corner. The door across the way leads back to the living room.

scenes.title: Bathroom
scenes.caption: A clean bathroom with a vessel-sink vanity, WC and a glass-partitioned shower.
scenes.description: A tidy bathroom finished in large beige tiles. A wooden vanity with a granite top holds a white vessel sink and a framed mirror, alongside a wall-mounted WC with a health faucet. A curved glass partition screens a walk-in shower with an overhead rain head. Towels hang on a rail by the door, which opens onto the hallway connecting back to the living and bedroom areas.
scenes.narration: Here's the bathroom — neat and practical, with a vessel-sink vanity, a wall-hung WC, and a glass-partitioned shower with a rain head. There's a towel rail by the door and plenty of natural light from the small window. Step back through the door to return to the main living area.

scenes.title: Balcony
scenes.caption: A road-facing balcony with seating, planters and a view over New Gurgaon.
scenes.description: A 15' x 5' road-facing balcony running along the front of the apartment, with a steel-railed parapet and a sweeping view of New Gurgaon's residential towers. Wicker seating with a glass-top table makes a relaxed corner, surrounded by potted plants and railing planters. A clothes-drying rack and laundry along one side mark its everyday use. Sliding glass doors on either end connect back into the living area and the bedroom.
scenes.narration: And here's the road-facing balcony — fifteen feet of outdoor space looking out over the towers of New Gurgaon. There's a cozy wicker seating corner, plenty of planters, and room for the everyday drying rack. On a clear day it's a pleasant spot for morning tea. The sliding doors at each end lead back inside — one to the living area, the other to the bedroom.
